introduction.title: Welcome to Pattern Learning
introduction.content: This tool helps you discover hidden patterns in number sequences. More than just solving—learn how to think about patterns, understand mathematical relationships, and predict what comes next.

how_to_use.title: How to Use
how_to_use.intro: Enter a sequence of numbers separated by commas or spaces. The solver will analyze the pattern and predict the next number.

invalid_examples.title: Invalid Input & Error Messages
invalid_examples.too_few: Too few numbers: <1>3, 5</1> → "Need at least 3 numbers"
invalid_examples.non_numeric: Text in sequence: <1>2, four, 6</1> → "Invalid number format"

guidelines.title: Input Guidelines
guidelines.tip1: Use at least 3 numbers for accurate pattern detection
guidelines.tip2: Separate numbers with commas or spaces
guidelines.tip4: Both integers and decimals are supported

recognition_guide.title: How to Recognize Patterns
recognition_guide.intro: Before the tool solves it, try identifying the pattern yourself! Here's a simple strategy:

step1.title: Step 1: Check the Differences
step1.desc: Subtract each number from the next. If differences are constant, it's <1>Arithmetic</1>.

step2.title: Step 2: Check the Ratios
step2.desc: Divide each number by the previous one. If ratios are constant, it's <1>Geometric</1>.

step3.title: Step 3: Check for Alternating or Complex Patterns
step3.desc: If neither works, look for alternating sequences or special patterns like Fibonacci.

api_key.title: Complex Patterns & API Key
api_key.intro: Most patterns work offline, but some require Google's Gemini AI for advanced reasoning.

basic_features.title: Available Without API Key (Offline)
basic_features.patterns: Arithmetic, Geometric, Two-Level Difference, Perfect Powers, Fibonacci

advanced_features.title: Requires Gemini API Key
advanced_features.patterns: Interleaved sequences, Complex alternating patterns, Abstract logic puzzles
advanced_features.example3: Complex logic: <1>1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8</1> (if not detected as Fibonacci) → Needs API key

api_key.note: After getting the key, verify your project link and billing account if necessary.

arithmetic.name: Arithmetic Progression
arithmetic.desc: Each number increases or decreases by a constant value
arithmetic.thought_process: Look for: Are the differences between consecutive numbers always the same?

geometric.name: Geometric Progression
geometric.desc: Each number is multiplied or divided by a constant ratio
geometric.thought_process: Look for: Do you multiply or divide by the same number each time?

fibonacci.name: Fibonacci Sequence
fibonacci.desc: Each number is the sum of the previous two numbers
fibonacci.thought_process: Look for: Does adding the last two numbers give you the next one?

triangular.name: Triangular Numbers
triangular.desc: Differences between numbers increase by 1 each time
triangular.thought_process: Look for: Do differences form a sequence like 1, 2, 3, 4...?

interleaved.name: Interleaved Sequences
interleaved.desc: Two separate patterns alternating position by position
interleaved.thought_process: Look for: Are odd positions and even positions following different rules?

perfect_powers.name: Perfect Squares/Cubes
perfect_powers.desc: Numbers are perfect powers of integers (n², n³, etc.)
perfect_powers.thought_process: Look for: Are these numbers you get by squaring or cubing integers?

two_level.name: Two-Level Difference
two_level.desc: Differences aren't constant, but the change in differences is constant
two_level.thought_process: Look for: If differences vary, check if the differences of differences are constant.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Welcome to Deret Solver. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we handle your information when you use our service.

information_collection.title: Information We Collect
information_collection.intro: When you use Deret Solver, we may collect the following information:

usage_data.title: Usage Data:
usage_data.content: We collect information about how you interact with our service, including the sequences you solve and features you use. User feedback (ratings, comments) and related sequence data are stored to improve our service.

analytics_data.title: Analytics Data:
analytics_data.content: We use Google Analytics to understand how users interact with our website, which helps us improve the service.

technical_data.title: Technical Data:
technical_data.content: We may collect information about your browser type, device, and IP address for security and performance purposes.

information_usage.title: How We Use Your Information
information_usage.intro: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
information_usage.provide_service: To provide and maintain our service
information_usage.improve_experience: To improve and optimize user experience
information_usage.analyze_usage: To analyze usage patterns and trends
information_usage.detect_issues: To detect and prevent technical issues or abuse

data_security.title: Data Storage and Security
data_security.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your information. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

third_party.title: Third-Party Services
third_party.intro: We use third-party services that may collect information used to identify you:

google_analytics.title: Google Analytics:
google_analytics.content: For analyzing website usage and traffic patterns

recaptcha.title: Google reCAPTCHA:
recaptcha.content: For protecting against spam and abuse

firebase.title: Firebase:
firebase.content: For hosting, database storage (Firestore), and analytics services

gemini_api.title: Google Gemini API:
gemini_api.content: We use Google's Gemini AI to process and solve advanced number sequences. Your input data is sent to Google for this specific processing purpose.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our service and store certain information. Cookies are files with a small amount of data which may include an anonymous unique identifier.

user_rights.title: Your Rights
user_rights.access: Access the personal information we hold about you

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Our service is available to users of all ages. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal data, please contact us.

policy_changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
policy_changes.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the feedback form available on our website.

quiz.description: Find the missing number in the sequence.

explanations.square: The terms are squares of consecutive integers ({{start}}², {{start_1}}², ...). The next is {{start_len}}² = {{next}}.
explanations.cube: The terms are cubes of consecutive integers ({{start}}³, {{start_1}}³, ...). The next is {{start_len}}³ = {{next}}.
explanations.fibonacci: Each number is the sum of the previous two numbers. {{last}} + {{last_prev}} = {{next}}.
explanations.prime: The sequence consists of consecutive prime numbers. The next prime after {{last}} is {{next}}.
explanations.factorial: The terms are factorials of consecutive integers ({{start}}!, {{start_1}}!, ...). The next is {{start_len}}! = {{next}}.
explanations.two_level: The differences between terms are {{diffs}}. These differences increase by {{diffInc}}. The next difference is {{nextDiff}}. {{last}} + {{nextDiff}} = {{next}}.
